title: Creator & Influencer Manager
description:
Creator & Influencer Manager — JOGA

About JOGA

JOGA is the fastest growing football brand in the world. We make products for footballers — shin pads, grip socks, recovery gear, and more. Worn by Premier League players, academy kids, and ballers everywhere. We're on a mission to bring football back to its roots.

The Role

We're looking for someone to build and run our creator and influencer machine. Your job is simple: get JOGA products into the hands of as many relevant creators and influencers as possible, every single day. This isn't a strategy-heavy role — it's high volume outreach, relationship building, and making sure our brand is everywhere.

What You'll Do



Outreach to micro-influencers, football creators, and athletes all day, every day — across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and X

Source and onboard creators in our current markets (UK, Ireland) and new markets (US, Australia, Europe, South Africa)

Manage product seeding — getting the right products to the right people quickly, especially around new product launches and key campaigns (preseason, Black Friday, World Cup)

Run and manage our affiliate program through Social Snowball — onboarding creators, tracking performance, optimising codes and commissions

Build a pipeline so we always have a steady flow of new creators posting about JOGA and JOGA Starz

Coordinate with our team on what products to push, which markets to target, and which creators to prioritise

Track results — not just vanity metrics, but which creators are actually driving content we can use and traffic that converts



What We're Looking For



Someone who lives on social media and understands football culture — you know which creators are popping, which ones are authentic, and which ones are a waste of time

High energy, high volume. This is a numbers game. You should be comfortable sending 50-100+ outreach messages per day

Organised enough to manage hundreds of creator relationships without things falling through the cracks

Experience with affiliate platforms (Social Snowball, GoAffPro, or similar) is a plus but not essential — we'll train you

Loves football. Non-negotiable. You need to understand the culture to know who's worth reaching out to

Based anywhere — this is a remote role. But you need to be responsive and proactive, not waiting to be told what to do



What You're NOT



This isn't a social media manager role — you won't be posting on our accounts

This isn't a paid influencer negotiation role — we're focused on free product seeding and affiliate partnerships, not big paid deals

This isn't a part-time gig — we want someone fully dedicated to building this system



Compensation

Competitive monthly salary + performance bonus based on creator volume and content output. We want someone hungry who sees the opportunity to grow with us as we scale globally.

description:
This is a 5-day-a-week role. You must be available every business day. We are replacing a part-time office administrator because the role now requires daily coverage, especially around month-end progress claims, weekly payroll, and during business hours when our Australian clients call.



About Us

We are RS Conform, an Australian construction company delivering mechanical, electrical, and civil engineering packages for Tier 1 main contractors including Lendlease, Multiplex, John Holland, CPB, Built, Hutchinson, and BESIX Watpac.

Our current work includes fire system pipework, drainage, pump rooms, carriageway installations, and large-scale M&E packages on data centre, pharmaceutical, and infrastructure projects.

The company is growing fast. We need a sharp, responsive, organised office allrounder to own the back-office administration on our live projects, including payroll, progress claims, and day-to-day client coordination, working directly with the company director.



What You'll Be Doing



Weekly payroll processing. Collecting timesheets from site staff, reconciling hours, calculating overtime and allowances, processing payments through Xero (or similar), and resolving payroll queries.

Owning the monthly progress claim cycle end to end: gathering site data, preparing claim schedules, submitting through main contractor portals (Procore, Aconex, Hammertech, Workbench), and chasing approvals.

Preparing and tracking variations, EOT (Extension of Time) submissions, and contract correspondence under Australian construction contracts (AS 4000, AS 2124, AS 4902).

Acting as the first point of contact for client project managers, contract administrators, and supplier accounts teams. Answering the phone, replying to
s the same business day, and keeping every thread moving.

Maintaining the project cost tracker in Excel: claimed to date, certified to date, variations approved, retention held, outstanding amounts.

Following up overdue payments with main contractor accounts teams. Polite, professional, and persistent.

Preparing subcontractor payment schedules and reconciling against supplier invoices.

Issuing and tracking RFIs, site instructions, and contract notices under Security of Payment legislation.

General office administration: filing, document control in SharePoint, scheduling meetings, organising travel for site visits when needed.

Producing a weekly status report for the director: payroll processed, open claims, outstanding payments, upcoming deadlines, and any client issues.





What We Need From You

Experience (Must-Have)



Minimum 3 years as an office administrator, contracts administrator, project coordinator, or similar all-rounder role in construction, engineering, or a related project-based industry.

Hands-on experience running payroll for at least 10 employees (timesheets, overtime, allowances, payment runs).

Proven experience preparing and submitting progress claims under Australian, UK, NZ, or Middle East construction contracts.

Experience working with Tier 1 main contractors or as a subcontractor administrator is strongly preferred.

Familiarity with Australian Security of Payment Act processes is a big plus. If you've worked under UK JCT or Middle East FIDIC contracts and are willing to learn, still apply.



Software



Excellent Excel (formulas, pivots, lookups, conditional formatting). You will live in Excel.

Xero,  for payroll and invoice reconciliation.

Experience with at least one main contractor portal: Procore, Aconex, Hammertech, Workbench, Jobpac, or Cheops.

Microsoft 365 (Outlook, SharePoint, Teams).



Language & Communication



Excellent written and spoken English. You will be on the phone with Australian project managers and contract admins every day. Clear accent, confident phone manner, and professional
 tone are non-negotiable.

Comfortable on Zoom and Teams calls.

Able to write a professional contract notice or chase-up
 without supervision.



Personality / Work Style



Highly responsive. You answer your phone. You reply to
s the same day. If you cannot answer, you let people know when you will.

Organised and methodical. You track everything, nothing falls through the cracks.

Self-managing. You can run the claims cycle without being chased.

Honest about what you don't know, and quick to ask when something is unclear.

Reliable internet, quiet home workspace, backup power if possible.





What We Offer



Competitive salary, paid in USD via Wise or Payoneer.



Day-shift hours. Work normal daytime hours and keep your evenings free, a major advantage over US or European employers.

Long-term, stable position. We want someone to grow with us, not a short-term contractor.

Direct working relationship with the company director.

Performance bonuses tied to claims approved on time and overdue debtor reduction.

Genuinely interesting projects with Tier 1 main contractors on large-scale infrastructure.





How to Apply

To apply, send a message with the following. Applications missing any of these will not be reviewed:



Subject line: "Office Allrounder Application, [Your Name], Tier One"

Your CV (PDF).

A short paragraph (200 words max) describing the most complex progress claim or variation you've personally prepared and submitted. What was the project value, what made it complicated, did it get certified, and what did you learn?

A short paragraph (100 words max) describing how many employees you've processed payroll for, what software you used, and any tricky payroll situation you've resolved (back-pay, overtime disputes, missing timesheets).

A screenshot or sample of a claims tracker, cost report, or contract correspondence you've produced (anonymised, remove client names if confidential).

Your expected monthly salary in USD.

Your availability to start and confirmation that you can work Monday to Friday, Australian Eastern hours.

Your internet speed test result (
 or speedtest.net screenshot).

A 30 to 60 second voice recording introducing yourself and describing one time you handled a difficult phone call. We need to hear your spoken English and phone manner.



We will respond to all qualifying applications within 7 days. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a paid 3-hour test task (preparing a sample progress claim and processing a sample payroll run), followed by a video interview.

We look forward to meeting you.

title: Finance & Operations Controller (Remote) Personal Development / Events / AI Company
description:
# Finance & Operations Controller (Remote)



## Personal Development / Events / AI Company



We are a fast-growing international company in the personal development, live events, coaching, speaking, and AI space seeking a highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented Finance & Operations Controller to help bring financial structure, accountability, collections, reporting, and operational stability into the company.



This role includes bookkeeping responsibilities, but extends far beyond traditional bookkeeping into operational finance management, collections, reporting, payment tracking, spending visibility, membership/payment management, and financial accountability.



We are looking for someone who can help organize and stabilize the financial and operational side of a rapidly scaling global business that runs:



* live transformational events

* memberships

* coaching programs

* certifications

* online education

* recurring payment plans

* international promoter partnerships

* affiliate payouts

* coaching teams

* AI-focused business initiatives



The ideal person is highly proactive, trustworthy, emotionally intelligent, detail-oriented, calm under pressure, excellent with follow-up, and able to create order from complexity.



This is a long-term growth opportunity with a mission-driven international company.



---



# Core Responsibilities



## Financial Tracking & Bookkeeping



* Maintain accurate financial records and bookkeeping

* Reconcile payment reports across Stripe, Kajabi, ThriveCart, PayPal, bank transfers, and other systems

* Track recurring revenue, payment plans, collections, and outstanding balances

* Monitor promoter payouts, event revenues, commissions, and operational expenses

* Maintain organized spreadsheets, reports, dashboards, and financial records

* Help clean up and organize historical financial records

* Assist with preparing documentation for accountants and tax professionals

* Potentially assist with back-tax organization and cleanup preparation



---



## Collections & Payment Follow-Up



* Follow up professionally with students whose payments fail or become overdue

* Coordinate collections and payment recovery efforts

* Reduce revenue leakage caused by missed or failed payments

* Work with customer support and operations teams regarding payment issues

* Ensure payment plans remain active and monitored consistently

* Follow up with promoters and partners regarding payouts and receivables



---



## Membership & Access Management



* Track which students and members should have access to programs, coaching, mentoring, certifications, and events

* Coordinate removal of access for inactive or non-paying members

* Maintain organized records of active students, memberships, certifications, coaching access, and payment status

* Help ensure operational integrity between payments and access permissions



---



## Cash Flow & Spending Control



* Track company spending and operational expenses

* Maintain visibility of current cash position and upcoming obligations

* Help leadership monitor operating runway and cash reserves

* Flag unusual, unnecessary, or unapproved expenses

* Maintain organized reporting for subscriptions, vendor payments, payroll obligations, event costs, coaching payouts, affiliate commissions, and operational expenses

* Help create stronger financial discipline and spending accountability across the organization

* Prepare weekly and monthly financial visibility reports for leadership



---



## Promoter & Partner Financial Coordination



* Help track promoter receivables, payouts, expenses, and payment timing

* Help prepare payout summaries and reconciliation reports

* Track commissions, splits, operational deductions, and financial distributions accurately

* Ensure visibility and accountability between all parties

* Help maintain clean records of agreements, payouts, and operational expenses



---



## Reporting & Financial Organization



* Organize reporting related to:



  * recurring revenue

  * collections

  * event profitability

  * payment plan performance

  * outstanding receivables

  * operating expenses

  * monthly burn

  * available cash

  * liabilities and obligations

* Maintain accurate financial data so leadership can make strategic projections and decisions

* Assist in creating systems, SOPs, workflows, and operational reporting structures



---



## Administrative & Operational Support



* Help organize contracts, payment records, invoices, and financial documentation

* Assist leadership with operational coordination related to payments and finance

* Help create stronger operational systems as the company scales internationally

* Help centralize and organize financial and operational information across the business



---



# Platforms & Tools



Experience with some or most of the following is preferred:



* QuickBooks Online

* Stripe

* Kajabi

* ThriveCart

* PayPal

* Google Sheets / Excel

* Zapier

* Slack / WhatsApp

* Google Drive



---



# Ideal Skills & Experience



* Strong English communication

* Excellent Google Sheets / Excel skills

* Strong bookkeeping/accounting fundamentals

* Extremely detail-oriented and organized

* Strong follow-through and accountability mindset

* Experience with subscriptions, memberships, payment plans, collections, or online education businesses

* Comfortable working inside fast-moving entrepreneurial companies

* Experience with customer collections and payment recovery is a major plus

* Ability to manage confidential financial information professionally



---



# Personality Traits We Value



* Proactive

* Calm under pressure

* Loyal and trustworthy

* Emotionally intelligent

* Excellent communicator

* Highly structured

* Consistent follow-through

* Solution-oriented

* Takes ownership without constant supervision

* Comfortable creating order from complexity



---



# Compensation



Initial compensation range:

$800–$1,200 USD/month depending on experience, skill level, availability, and capability.



Potential for:



* long-term growth

* increased responsibility

* leadership opportunities

* performance bonuses

* expanded operational role as the company scales



---



# To Apply



Please send:



1. Your resume or background experience

2. Your experience with bookkeeping, operational finance, collections, or financial management

3. Experience working with coaching, education, membership, or event-based businesses

4. Examples of systems, dashboards, or reporting you’ve created

We are looking for someone who wants to grow long-term with a meaningful international company focused on transformation, leadership, education, AI, and human potential.

We bridge the gap between high-tech operations and real-world execution. By using advanced CRM systems and internal AI tools to automate our back-end busywork, we free up our management team to focus on what matters most: high-level human communication, real-time logistics, and pristine service delivery. As our Operations Manager, you are the air traffic controller of our daily business. You will take full ownership of our active technician, subcontractor, and service provider network. Real-Time Problem Solving & Rerouting: When a technician gets stuck, a truck breaks down, or a job runs over, you step in. You will quickly reroute jobs, adjust schedules in the CRM, and make sure no customer is left hanging.



Proprietary Systems Management: Live inside our custom CRM and internal platforms to track job progress, verify completion photos, sign off on technician payouts, and keep the data 100% clean.



What We Need From You:



Super Crisp, Clear English (No Accent): This is a non-negotiable requirement. You are the premium face of our brand. You will be speaking with high-value US customers, property managers, and field technicians daily. Your communication must be flawless and confident.



High-Volume Operations Experience: You thrive in fast-paced environments. You have experience managing moving parts—ideally in dispatching, logistics, field service management, or high-volume project management.



Proprietary Software & CRM Mastery: You are highly tech-savvy. You can navigate complex CRMs, communication tools (Slack, Loom, WhatsApp Business), and learn custom proprietary software quickly.



Thick Skin & Problem-Solving Brain: In field operations, things change fast. You don’t panic when a schedule breaks; you instantly find a solution, reroute the team, and keep moving.

title: Construction Estimator (Buildertrend)
description:
You have the AU construction knowledge. Now find the role that actually uses it!



Go Ignite is hiring a skilled Estimator for a fully remote, full-time role based in the Philippines.



About the opportunity

A legitimate AU construction career — without leaving home



You've built your estimating skills around Australian construction standards, learned the NCC, and gotten comfortable working with AU-based teams across time zones. But finding a remote role that actually matches that experience — with stable hours, a professional setup, and work that challenges you — hasn't been easy.



This is that role:

You'll be embedded directly into an Australian building and property services business, managing real tender pipelines and cost estimates for residential and commercial projects — working Philippine hours, from your home office, with weekends to yourself.



About the company:

An Australian building and property services business built on quality and efficiency



We are a growing Australian construction and trades company operating across residential and commercial sectors. We run a modern, systems-driven operation using Buildertrend to manage project workflows end-to-end — from initial quote through to delivery.



We’re expanding our remote team and are looking for a sharp, self-directed estimator who takes ownership of their numbers.



The role: Estimator:

You will be the primary estimating resource for the business — responsible for preparing accurate, competitive cost estimates and tender submissions for Australian construction projects.



Working closely with the project management and operations team, you will ensure every bid is grounded in solid data, clear scope, and fully compliant with Australian building standards.



What you'll be doing:

Estimating and cost planning

-Prepare detailed and accurate cost estimates for residential and commercial construction projects from supplied plans and specifications

-Conduct quantity take-offs from architectural and engineering drawings to determine material and labour requirements

-Analyse project scope documents, specifications, and site conditions to produce comprehensive and competitive quotes

-Develop and maintain a cost database of materials, labour rates, and subcontractor pricing to support efficient estimation

-Review and update estimates as project scope or design changes occur throughout the pre-construction phase



Tendering and bid management

-Prepare and submit well-structured tender documents, pricing schedules, and supporting documentation within required deadlines

-Coordinate with subcontractors and suppliers to obtain competitive quotations and incorporate them into overall bid pricing

-Assess and evaluate subcontractor and supplier quotes for accuracy, scope coverage, and value for money

-Manage multiple tender submissions concurrently, maintaining a tender register and tracking outcomes to improve win rates over time

-Buildertrend and project system management

-Utilise Buildertrend to manage and track estimate data, project budgets, and pre-construction documentation

-Upload and maintain project files, drawings, and specifications within Buildertrend for team-wide accessibility

-Generate and export cost reports and estimate summaries from Buildertrend for review by project managers and leadership

-Assist in configuring and updating Buildertrend templates to reflect current pricing and scope structures

-Ensure all estimate-related data within Buildertrend is accurate, current, and properly categorised at all times



Australian building code and compliance awareness

-Apply knowledge of the National Construction Code (NCC) and relevant Australian Standards when assessing project scope and specifications

-Identify compliance requirements related to structural, safety, and regulatory standards when reviewing plans

-Flag potential cost impacts arising from code compliance obligations and communicate these clearly to the project team

-Stay current with updates to Australian building codes, industry standards, and best practice requirements



Coordination and stakeholder communication

-Collaborate closely with the project management and operations team to clarify scope and resolve estimating queries in a timely manner

-Communicate estimate assumptions, inclusions, and exclusions clearly in writing to support informed decision-making by the client team

-Participate in regular virtual meetings with the leadership team to review tender pipelines and project pricing strategies

-Support handover of awarded projects to the project delivery team by documenting estimate assumptions and budget allocations



What you'll bring:

-Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in construction estimating, with exposure to Australian residential or commercial projects

-Demonstrated proficiency in Buildertrend for estimate management, project documentation, and cost reporting

-Working knowledge of the National Construction Code (NCC) and relevant Australian construction standards

-Strong ability to read and interpret architectural and engineering drawings, specifications, and tender documents

-Excellent written and verbal English communication skills suited to a remote, cross-timezone collaboration environment

-Experience with quantity surveying or cost planning methodologies is an advantage

-Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated professional home office setup



Why this opportunity is different:

Stable hours. Consistent work. A team that values precision.



This isn't project-based or seasonal work. You're joining a full-time operation with a structured day shift schedule and weekends off — meaning your work life is predictable and your personal time is protected.



The business is operationally mature and systems-driven. You'll work with proper tooling, clear processes, and a team that respects the craft of good estimating.



If you've been looking for a long-term remote role where your technical skills are taken seriously, this is it.



Compensation and benefits

-Full-time engagement — 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday

-Day shift schedule with weekends off

-Monthly salary of PHP 45,000 to PHP 55,000, commensurate with experience + Performance bonus

-Paid time off + Prepaid HMO 



How to apply:

Ready to bring your AU construction knowledge into a role that values it?



Send your CV to GO Recruit along with a brief response to the screening question below. We review every application personally — but applications submitted without a response to the screening question will not be progressed.

Screening question: 

1. Describe your experience using Buildertrend in a construction estimating context — specifically, how you have used it to manage estimate data, generate cost reports, or support tender submissions. 

2. If you have not used Buildertrend, tell us which estimating platform you have used and how your experience would transfer.

title: Customer Onboarding & Technical Support Specialist (Mac & Windows)
description:
About Caddy



Caddy is an AI productivity tool that customers install on their own Mac or Windows machines. Every customer goes through a guided install call before they can use the product. Right now I run those calls personally. I am hiring this role to take that over and to handle support after the install.



What you will do



1. Run customer install calls.

   Most calls are 60 to 90 minutes on Zoom or Google Meet with screenshare. You walk the customer through commands in Terminal (Mac) or PowerShell (Windows). You explain what each step does in plain language so non-technical customers feel comfortable. You troubleshoot when something does not go to plan (PATH issues, Gatekeeper prompts on Mac, permission popups, plugin install errors, etc).



2. Send the welcome
 and run the GitHub access steps live on the call.

   I will give you a runbook that lists every step in order.



3. Handle the customer support inbox after install.

   You triage incoming
, answer the easy questions yourself, draft replies for me to review on the harder ones, and flag anything that looks urgent.



4. Keep our internal runbook accurate.

   When you find a step that confused a customer or a fix that worked, you update the runbook so the next install goes smoother.



Who you are



- Comfortable in the command line on both Mac (Terminal, Homebrew) AND Windows (PowerShell, Scoop). This is non-negotiable since our customers are split across both.

- Excellent spoken and written English. You will be on live calls with US-based business owners.

- Patient and calm with non-technical people. You can explain what a "package manager" is to someone who has never opened Terminal before.

- Strong troubleshooting instincts. When something breaks mid-install, you stay composed and work it through.

- Reliable on a US-overlap schedule. Most install calls will be booked during US business hours (Pacific or Central).



Nice to have



- Prior experience with Claude Code, Cursor, or any AI developer tool.

- Familiarity with GitHub (you will be adding customers as collaborators to private repos).

- Prior SaaS customer support experience.



What we offer



- Stable full-time role with a single owner (me) as your only point of contact.

- Clear runbooks for every step you will do.

- 13th month pay.

- Paid Philippine holidays.

- Performance bonuses as the customer base grows.



How to apply



In your application, please answer these three questions in your own words:



1. Have you used Terminal on a Mac or PowerShell on Windows? Briefly describe the most technical thing you have done in either.

2. What is the most recent piece of technology, software, or app you taught yourself how to use? How did you learn it (videos, articles, trial and error, asking someone)?

3. What is your timezone, and what hours can you reliably be online for US calls?

4. What attracts you to this specific role? Be specific about what stood out to you in this job post compared to other jobs you have applied to.



Applications without answers to these four questions will not be reviewed.

description:
READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING

We are not looking for someone we have to train, babysit, or hand-hold. If you need someone to tell you what to test, how to structure a campaign, or how to make creatives — this is not the role for you. 



Who we are

We run affiliate marketing campaigns on
 and Instagram at scale. We move fast, we measure everything, and we only keep what works. We are looking for a media buyer who can operate independently, own their numbers, and drive profitable results without needing direction on the basics.



What you will own

- Launching, scaling, and optimizing paid campaigns on
 & Instagram Ads Manager from day one

- Managing your own ad accounts — structuring campaigns, testing audiences, and cutting losers fast

- Producing or sourcing your own creatives — we do not have a creative team waiting for your brief

- Hitting and improving ROI targets consistently — your pay is tied to your results



What we provide

- Tools to help with creative strategy

- High level performance marketing director to provide guidance throughout 

- competitive compensation structure (the better results you get, the more pay you receive)



HARD REQUIREMENTS

If you cannot meet all of these, do not apply.

1. Proven ROI. You must be able to show specific ROI numbers you have achieved — not ranges, not estimates. Real numbers from real campaigns.

2. Ads Manager screenshots. You must provide full, unedited screenshots from
 Ads Manager — not cropped, not filtered. The screenshots must clearly show the date range of the data, the account spend, and the results. We will not accept analytics dashboards, third-party tools, or blurred-out figures.

3. Industry experience. State clearly which industries or niches you have run paid traffic in. Affiliate marketing experience is a strong advantage. Generic "e-commerce" without specifics is not enough.

4. Agency or independent track record. Tell us whether you have worked in-house, at an agency, or independently — and what level of ad spend you have personally managed.

5. Creative self-sufficiency. You know how to make or source your own ad creatives. We can provide insight on what is working for us and can provide pointers, but we will not be briefing you, supplying assets, or reviewing drafts. You are expected to test and iterate on your own.

6. Zero hand-holding. You must be able to run your accounts without daily check-ins, account monitoring, or strategy input from us. We will be their as guidance, but we cannot hand hold you through the entire process. 



Compensation

Your earning potential is directly tied to the results you produce. Strong performers earn well. This is a performance based compensation (base + commission)



HOW TO APPLY

Send a message that includes all of the following. Incomplete applications will be ignored.



1. Your specific ROI figures from past campaigns (include the niche/industry)

2. Full Ads Manager screenshots showing date range, spend, and results — no cropping, no editing

3. A brief breakdown of which industries/niches you have worked in as a media buyer

4. In the subject field, write "Performance Marketing" otherwise you will be ignored. 

5. Whether you have worked at an agency, independently, or in-house — and the monthly ad spend you managed

6. A one-paragraph explanation of how you approach creative testing without outside support



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not receive a response. No exceptions.

title: AI-Powered Video Content Modernisation
description:
1. Project Overview & Trial Scope



We are an established Human Resources Consulting practice in Australia with online module content. We have reconfigured two core courses ach of them needing an avatar and a specific voice over that mimics our speaker who appears on other videos as a live presenter. 



Pilot Goal: To adapt one (1) trial video into a new format where the entire audio is replaced by the speaker's cloned voice, and the visuals feature AI-generated B-roll and a Custom AI Avatar of the speaker (sample will be provided).



Content Library State: We currently subscribed to ElevenLabs and HeyGen and can give you access to those subscriptions for this work and access to existing scripts. The average duration is approximately 4.6 minutes per video.

The contractor must deliver a fully edited video that meets these outcomes:



-Audio Replacement (Voice Cloning is Required): The contractor must use AI Voice Cloning technology to create the new voiceover in a voice cloned to sound like the original speaker. Same Australian accent (ideally)



-Custom AI Avatar Creation: Integrate a Custom AI Avatar (or digital spokesperson) to deliver key parts of the new narrative. The Avatar must be generated based on one of the following specifications:

   -An avatar generated to look like the original speaker



-Visual Enhancement (AI B-Roll): Generate new video clips (B-roll) using text prompts. These AI clips must be seamlessly edited over the speaker's footage to enhance the narrative.

  

-Final Delivery: Provide the final, high-resolution MP4 video file and a folder containing all original source files and all generated AI assets as the pilot and if successful for each video thereafter.





3. Tools & Collaboration (Flexible Workflow & Ownership)



We require the AI generation to use our system, but the assembly can use the contractor's preferred editor.



-Tool Flexibility and Editing Software: The contractor has the flexibility to use their preferred professional video editing software for the assembly of the final video. The contractor may also use their own preferred tools for initial preparation, but all final AI B-roll and script creation must be accounted for using the client-provided AI access (Note: We subscribed to HeyGen and ElevenLabs).





4. Contractor Profile



-We require a highly creative, technically proficient editor who can demonstrate mastery in advanced production workflows and cutting-edge Generative AI techniques, who can also deal with quality, volume and working to deadlines:



-Required Skills: Proven expertise in professional video editing and high-fidelity AI Voice Cloning for precise voice replication and audio integration. At least Intermediate English Skills, written and verbal.

mbers in Slack

title: Customer Success Manager (SaaS Video Marketing)
description:
Customer Success Manager (SaaS Video Marketing)



Location: Remote, Philippines

Type: Full-time

Salary: $1,600 - $1,800 USD/Month

Hours: 10 pm - 6 am (Manila time) or 8 pm - 4 am (Manila time) 



ABOUT SPARKPORTAL

At SparkPortal, we provide video content strategy and production specifically for SaaS and B2B companies. Our differentiator from other video agencies is that our business model is Video-as-a-Service. Unlike other video agencies, we work closer to the customer as their internal video team. Our clients trust our advice and follow our instructions instead of just submitting order requests. 60% of the videos we make for our clients are animation and motion graphics projects (Explainers, Promos, and Sizzles). In comparison, 40% of the videos are video editing projects (Riverside Interviews & Testimonials, Podcasts, & Webinar repurposing)



THE CUSTOMER SUCCESS MANAGER ROLE

As a Customer Success hire at SparkPortal, you own the post-sale client relationship. Not creative direction (our Creative Director owns that). Not production timelines (our Project Manager owns those). The relationship. The thing that turns a new client into a long-term partnership 3-5 years long. Additionally, you'll work with the founder and the Creative Director to build customer success from the ground up.



THE THREEE OUTCOMES YOU OWN

1. Onboarding. Every new client hits their first video milestone on time, on scope, with zero confusion. You run kickoff, align on goals using SPICED, set the rhythm, and hand off cleanly to the CD and PM.



2. Adoption. Clients find our service valuable and useful because the videos we make are strategically aligned with their marketing goals. They show up to reviews, give feedback, renew briefs on time, and tell their boss SparkPortal is working. You drive the cadence and spot drop-offs before they become churn signals.



3. Renewal. Quarterly and annual retainers renew. No surprise churn. You own the health score, flag at-risk clients early, and drive renewal conversations. The founder closes. You set it up so closing is a formality. (We don’t have a strong expansion program yet, and we don’t plan to have one in the near term.)



DAY TO DAY

- Run kickoffs and document SPICED for each account

- Be the always-on point of contact for assigned clients

- Run biweekly meeting, check-ins, and quarterly business reviews

- Track account health and surface at-risk accounts to the founder

- Coordinate with the Creative Director on strategy and the Project Manager on delivery

- Spot expansion signals and hand them to the founder to close

- Build our CS playbooks as you go (we don't have these yet, you'll write them)



WHO YOU ARE

- 3-5 years in customer success, client success, or account management at a US-facing agency, SaaS, or marketing services business

- People oriented person

- Helper

- Problem solver 

- You've owned client relationships, not just supported them

- Native English or similar

- Comfortable with US time zone overlap

- Calm under pressure. You don't disappear when something goes sideways

- Curious about frameworks. We're building on Winning by Design, learn it with us

- Detail-obsessed about communication

- Bonus: video, creative, or content agency experience, or working with SaaS marketing teams



YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

- Day 30: get to know your clients by name, history, SPICED, and health

- Day 60: you own day-to-day client communication and the founder is out of routine comms

- Day 90: onboarding playbook documented v1, QBR template in place, every client has a health score and a renewal date



HOW TO APPLY

Submit your application here on onlinejobs.ph (Include your resume as a PDF and a link to your LinkedIn profile.)

title: Director of Customer Acquisition DTC
description:
Urgent Hiring — Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. The selection process may take up to 4 weeks, but early applicants are strongly encouraged.

Ready to build something that shapes the future?

Every parent wants to give their child the best start. They want to see curiosity light up their eyes. They want confidence, not constant screen time. They want learning to feel joyful again.



At Hadley Designs, we create screen-free tools that help families rediscover connection through hands-on learning. We are scaling quickly. We are building boldly. And we are looking for a leader who can turn vision into profitable growth.



That’s where you come in.



About Hadley Designs

Hadley Designs is a family-founded, female-led brand redefining early education through creativity, beauty, and connection. What began at a kitchen table has grown into a nationally loved brand trusted by millions of parents, grandparents, and teachers.



We believe learning should be fun and engaging.



We don’t just sell products, we shape futures.



We believe in screen-free, hands-on learning that builds confidence and connection. Beautiful design creates better learning.



Our mission is simple and powerful. Design screen-free products parents can trust to help their children learn, grow, and reach their full potential with confidence.



Our vision is bold. Build the most trusted children’s brand in the world. Reach $100M in revenue by 2030. Become a household name passed down for generations.



Now we are scaling our direct-to-consumer ecosystem. Shopify and TikTok Shop are our next major growth engines.



About the Role

As our Director of Customer Acquisition DTC, you are the General Manager of Shopify and TikTok Shop. You own the P&L. You own the strategy. You own the results.



Your Core Focus



-Scale Shopify and TikTok Shop to $20M+ in combined revenue within 18 months

-Achieve ?15% net margin on Shopify and ?5% on TikTok Shop

-Maintain Meta ROAS ? 2.0 and TikTok Shop ROAS ? 3.5

-Launch one new high-converting bundle-based funnel per month

-Drive
 and SMS to contribute ?25% of Shopify revenue

-Remove the CEO from daily ecommerce execution by owning strategy, systems, team, and outcomes



You are not here to manage tasks. You are here to architect a repeatable growth engine.



What You’ll Do



Traffic and Acquisition



-Partner with affiliate and UGC teams to scale winning creative

-Stay ahead of platform trends, formats, and policy updates

-Coordinate launches with Amazon for halo effects



Offers, Funnels, and CRO

-Oversee homepage, product pages, and collection merchandising

-Refactor and relaunch underperforming funnels with new hooks and offers

-Lead seasonal promotions including Back-to-School and Holiday campaigns

-Build and maintain funnel SOPs and testing roadmaps



Customer Nurture and LTV



-Lead lifecycle marketing through Klaviyo and Postscript

-Optimize welcome, cart abandonment, post-purchase, and win-back flows

-Build ascension paths from posters to workbooks to busy books

-Develop blog and SEO strategy to drive organic education-based traffic



Performance and Forecasting



-Review weekly P&Ls for Shopify and TikTok Shop

-Analyze AOV, CVR, CAC, LTV, ROAS, GP to CAC, and lifecycle revenue share

-Deliver weekly scorecards and monthly strategic growth plans

-Forecast performance and identify scaling levers



Team Leadership



-Lead and coach a cross-functional ecommerce pod of 6+ tea
mbers

-Establish clear ownership and weekly operating rhythms

-Hire and develop talent as funnel velocity increases

-Manage freelancers and specialized contractors

-Model Extreme Ownership, Relentless Innovation, and Integrity 

Above All



How Success Is Measured



-$20M+ DTC revenue within 18 months

-Consistent margin and ROAS targets achieved

-One profitable funnel launch per month


 and SMS driving at least 25% of Shopify revenue

-Documented systems that scale without founder dependency

-A high-performing team executing without burnout



Requirements



Who You Are



You think like a General Manager, not just a marketer.



You thrive in ownership. You love numbers. You respect creative. You build systems that make growth inevitable.



You align deeply with our values:



-Extreme Ownership. You solve problems and close loops without excuses.

-Relentless Innovation. You test boldly, learn fast, and iterate constantly.

-Integrity Above All. You report numbers accurately and tell the truth even when it is hard.



Experience That Sets You Apart



-5 to 10+ years in DTC ecommerce, especially Shopify and paid social

-Proven track record scaling ecommerce brands past $20M

-Experience owning revenue and profitability targets

-Deep expertise in Meta and TikTok Ads

-Hands-on experience with Klaviyo, Postscript, and Shopify CMS

-Strong background in bundles, upsells, and LTV optimization

-Ability to write and review high-converting landing pages

-Comfortable leading a fully remote team with clear weekly cadences



You are analytical and creative. Strategic and operational. Visionary and accountable.



You care about building something that lasts.



Benefits

Why You’ll Love Working Here



-You will have real ownership. Real trust. And real impact.

-Hadley Designs is a remote first company built on autonomy, creativity, and accountability.

-You will work closely with leadership, including the CEO, while having full authority to own your channels and decisions.

-Access to ongoing learning, training, and tools to sharpen your knowledge and strategies in the DTC space.

-You will be surrounded by A+ tea
mber that value excellence, growth, and doing the right thing.

nts into meaningful learning experiences.



But none of that works without a seamless, trustworthy customer experience. A store that runs flawlessly. Messaging that is clear. Operations that feel effortless to the customer.



That’s where you come in.



About Hadley Designs

We believe learning should be fun and engaging. We don’t just sell products, we shape futures. Our mission is to create screen-free, hands-on learning tools that build confidence, spark curiosity, and bring families closer together.



Every product we design is rooted in purpose. Beautiful design creates better learning, and every detail matters. From the first click to the 
nt a child lights up with understanding, we are committed to delivering an experience families can trust.



About the Role

DTC Operations Manager

Also known as: Shopify Operations Manager | Ecommerce Operations Lead | Customer Experience Operations Manager



This role is the backbone of our direct-to-consumer experience. You will own the performance, accuracy, and clarity of our Shopify store from end to end.



Your mission is simple and powerful. Ensure every customer fully understands what they are buying and when they will receive it before they complete their purchase.



Your Core Focus

-Take full ownership of Shopify store operations and customer experience

-Eliminate inconsistencies across the site, including broken links, outdated promotions, and conflicting messaging

-Standardize shipping, split shipment, and pre-order communication across all touchpoints

-Build and document SOPs for all operational workflows

-Implement systems and automations that reduce manual work and customer confusion



What You’ll Do



Customer Experience Management (Daily)



-Respond to customer inquiries via Shopify inbox and social channels

-Triage and resolve support tickets based on urgency

-Identify patterns in customer feedback and recommend improvements

-Ensure all communication is clear, accurate, and aligned with current messaging



Order Operations and Fulfillment (Daily)



-Monitor order flow across Shopify, Base, and Amazon MCF

-Resolve failed orders, inventory issues, and discrepancies

-Coordinate with fulfillment teams to ensure timely delivery

-Manage split shipments, pre-orders, and out-of-stock scenarios

-Track and resolve missing or delayed packages



Store Integrity and Accuracy (Weekly)



-Audit the website for broken links, incorrect pricing, and outdated promotions

-Ensure consistency across product pages, landing pages, and collections

-Validate all messaging related to shipping and pre-orders

-Support promotion setup and ensure backend accuracy



Systems, SOPs, and Automation (Weekly)



-Build and maintain SOPs for recurring workflows

-Identify inefficiencies and implement automation using tools like Shopify Flow

-Optimize customer service platforms such as Gorgias

-Improve post-purchase experience and operational workflows

-Support system cleanup and tool evaluation



Growth Operations and Reporting (Weekly)



-Deliver weekly Shopify performance reports

-Track key metrics such as CAC, LTV, and funnel performance

-Identify trends, anomalies, and risks early

-Ensure data accuracy for decision-making



Compliance and Risk Management (Weekly)



-Maintain compliance across ADA, privacy policies, and tracking regulations

-Review product pages and campaigns for compliance risks

-Ensure all required tools and disclosures are functioning properly

-Stay updated on platform policies and changes



AI and Automation Ownership (Ongoing)



-Identify repetitive tasks and convert them into automated workflows

-Use AI tools to improve efficiency in customer service and operations

-Build prompt libraries and scalable systems

-Continuously reduce manual workload while maintaining accuracy



How Success Is Measured



-Reduction in support ticket rate per 1000 orders

-Reduction in reshipment rate per 1000 orders

-Zero compliance issues

-At least one new AI automation implemented per week

-Zero reported issues with broken links, incorrect promotions, or inaccurate information



Success looks like a store that runs without chaos. Orders flow cleanly. Customers feel confident. Problems are solved before they scale.



Requirements

Who You Are

You are a systems-driven operator who takes pride in getting the details right.



You think like an owner. You move quickly, solve problems independently, and take full responsibility for outcomes. You don’t wait for direction. You create clarity where others see complexity.



-You have 2 to 5 years of experience managing Shopify store operations

-You are highly detail-oriented and catch inconsistencies others miss

-You are a strong written communicator who can simplify complex information

-You have hands-on experience with order management, fulfillment, and customer service

-You understand Shopify apps, backend systems, and troubleshooting workflows

-You build systems, not just solutions

-You thrive in a fast-moving, high-growth environment

-You are comfortable working cross-functionally while maintaining ownership

-You believe in excellence over easy. You take initiative. You close loops. You care deeply about doing things the right way.



Benefits

Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Hadley Designs, your work directly impacts families around the world.



You are not just managing operations. You are helping create a seamless experience that allows parents to feel confident, supported, and proud of their choices.



You will enjoy:



-A remote-first environment that gives you flexibility and autonomy

-The ability to manage your schedule with trust and accountability

-Direct access to leadership and meaningful collaboration across teams

-Opportunities to build systems, implement ideas, and drive real impact

-Access to training, tools, and continuous learning

-A decade-strong, family-founded brand with a clear mission and vision

-Free access to products that are changing how children learn



Hadley Designs is a remote-first company built on trust, creativity, and autonomy. We’re a small but mighty team that believes in balancing excellence with flexibility.



Apply Today



Apply today and help us make learning fun, engaging, and screen-free for families everywhere.

title: Chief People Officer
description:
Ready to Empower a Growing Team and Shape Our Future?

At Hadley Designs, we believe that learning should be enjoyable, engaging, and screen-free. Millions of parents and teachers trust our beautifully designed, developmentally aligned educational tools to help children grow and thrive. As a fast-growing, family-founded brand, we are on a mission to make learning meaningful for families around the world.

We are seeking a Chief People Officer to join our team and build the systems that will drive our next phase of growth. If you are passionate about creating scalable people systems, empowering teams, and cultivating a culture that supports both personal and professional growth, this role offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact.



About Hadley Designs

Hadley Designs is redefining early education with creativity and purpose. Every product we create is hand-drawn and teacher-designed, crafted with care to build confidence and connection. Our screen-free tools help families and teachers make learning fun and meaningful, nurturing curiosity and creativity in children.



Our Mission:

We design screen-free products that parents can trust to help their children learn, grow, and reach their full potential. We create beautifully designed, developmentally sound tools that replace noise and distraction with connection, curiosity, and real learning.



Our Vision:

We aim to build the most trusted children’s brand in the world, present in millions of homes, reshaping how families learn, connect, and grow. Our products will be so widely used and passed down that generations of children will grow up learning from them and choose them again for their own families.



Role Overview

As the Chief People Officer, you will be responsible for leading the development of people systems and strategies that enable Hadley Designs to scale and grow. In this role, you will partner with leadership to create the talent systems required to attract, develop, and retain a high-performing workforce. Your focus will be on building scalable, high-performance systems that align with the company’s growth objectives and help foster a positive organizational culture.

This position offers a unique opportunity to shape how we build and nurture our team, enabling both the company and our people to succeed. You will play an integral role in supporting our mission by ensuring that Hadley Designs has the right talent and organizational structure to achieve long-term success.



Key Responsibilities

- People Systems Leadership: Design and implement systems for attracting, engaging, onboarding, and retaining talent, aligned with the company’s growth objectives. 

- Organizational Design and Capacity Planning: Collaborate with leadership to ensure that the organizational structure and workforce planning meet the evolving needs of the business. 

- Performance and Development Frameworks: Establish performance expectations, evaluation frameworks, and development pathways that drive accountability and growth across the organization. 

- Talent Experience and Retention: Build a consistent and professional experience for talent that reinforces employee engagement, satisfaction, and retention. 

- Workforce Insights and Reporting: Provide insights and data-driven recommendations to leadership to guide decision-making and improve workforce effectiveness. 

- External Partnerships: Partner with external service providers to enhance and support people operations as necessary.



How Success Is Measured

- Successful implementation of people systems that directly support the business’s ability to scale. 

- Strong employee retention rates, with high performance and engagement. 

- Improved leadership confidence in people systems, talent readiness, and organizational alignment. 

- Predictable, scalable people operations that contribute to the company’s growth and success.



Who You Are



You are a strategic, results-driven leader with a passion for creating systems that empower teams and enable sustainable growth. You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and have a track record of building effective people systems in alignment with business goals.



You Have:

- 5+ years of experience in People Operations, HR leadership, or a related field, ideally in a fast-growing environment. 

- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field. 

- Proven ability to build scalable systems that attract, develop, and retain talent. 

- Strong experience working with distributed and remote teams. 

- A passion for people development, with the ability to design and implement programs that foster growth, learning, and employee satisfaction. 

- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills at all levels of the organization. 

- A growth mindset and a collaborative approach to solving problems. 

- Experience using data to drive decisions and measure success.



Why You’ll Love Working Here

- Impact: Your work will directly impact how families experience learning through the Hadley Designs brand. 

- Culture: Join a passionate, mission-driven team that values trust, creativity, and collaboration. 

- Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of a remote role with flexible working hours. 

 

Benefits: 

- Remote-first work environment  

- Paid time off and holidays  

- Access to learning resources and professional development  

- Free access to Hadley Designs products 

- Regular interaction with leadership, including the CEO and CMO  

- Stability from a decade as a family-founded, mission-driven brand

title: Dedicated Virtual Assistant – Court Reporting Business (Long-Term)
description:
I'm a freelance court reporter based in Los Angeles. I work with agencies across Southern California covering depositions and court proceedings. I need a reliable, detail-oriented VA to become a permanent part of my team. This is a long-term role with growth potential, not a one-time gig.

What you'll do:

* Learn and work in On The Record (OTR), a project management app built specifically for court reporters. This is your primary tool.

* Create, track, and reconcile invoices for each job.

* Maintain job scheduling and calendar in OTR.

* Maintain income/expense records.

* Clear an existing data entry backlog as your first priority.

What I'm looking for:

* Detail-oriented and accurate

* Basic bookkeeping experience (invoicing, reconciliation, expense tracking)

* Comfortable learning new web apps

* Independent, reliable, and in it for the long term

* Excellent written English

Nice to have: Experience supporting a legal or professional services business, familiarity with any project management platform.

Hours/Location: Remote, flexible, async-friendly.

To apply: Tell me about yourself and your experience with data entry, invoicing, and bookkeeping. List any tools you've used. Experience supporting a solo professional is a plus. Prior work references.

Strong accountability

Leadership approves (10%)

Track all meeting to-dos

Complete system-related to-dos and process work

Delegate or push owners for execution work

title: Property Operations Assistant
description:
Freeman Real Estate Ltd (Property Operations Assistant)



Starting Monthly Retainer: £400 - £500 per month

Position Type: Full-time remote contractor



Introduction:



Freeman Real Estate is looking for a highly organised and proactive Operations Assistant to support the day-to-day running of our growing business.



This is a full-time remote role focused on supporting the business across finance administration, property onboarding, document management and general operational support. You will play an important role in helping ensure our landlords, housing providers, contractors and internal team are supported professionally and efficiently throughout the onboarding and management process.



We are looking for someone who is detail-oriented, reliable and comfortable managing administrative responsibilities across multiple areas of the business. The successful candidate will have strong organisational skills, excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently whilst maintaining a high level of accuracy and professionalism.



This role would suit someone who enjoys organisation, problem-solving and supporting business operations behind the scenes. We are looking for someone who is proactive, eager to learn and interested in developing long-term within a growing and professionally driven business. 



About the Role:



This role is focused on supporting the day-to-day operations of the business across finance administration, property onboarding and general operational support.



You will work closely with the directors, Tom and Nick, supporting the backend administration of the business and helping ensure day-to-day operations are managed efficiently, accurately and professionally.



A large part of the role will involve supporting the finance and onboarding processes across the business. Responsibilities will include generating and processing invoices, uploading invoices and statements, logging and reconciling payments, following up on outstanding payments, processing rental disbursements and maintaining accurate financial and administrative records within our systems.



You will also support with the onboarding of new landlords and properties, including collecting and organising compliance documentation, preparing tenancy and onboarding paperwork, saving and maintaining accurate records and supporting the coordination of property set-up and onboarding processes.



Alongside this, you may also provide support to the property management team where required, including assisting with maintenance administration, compliance-related tasks, certificate renewals, contractor coordination and general customer service support across our managed properties.



About Freeman Real Estate:



Freeman Real Estate is a specialist lettings agency operating within the supported housing and care sector.



We work closely with landlords, housing providers and care organisations across the Midlands to help facilitate long-term housing solutions for people in need of support or care.



Our role is to onboard and manage landlords’ properties whilst facilitating long-term lease agreements with housing providers. We act as a central point of coordination between landlords, housing providers and contractors to help ensure properties are managed professionally and relationships are maintained effectively throughout each lease.



Key Responsibilities:



• Generate, process and upload invoices, supplier invoices, statements and financial records accurately within company systems



• Log and reconcile rental payments, disbursements and contractor payments



• Follow up on outstanding invoices, rental payments and contractor payments where required



• Support the preparation and distribution of landlord statements, invoices and tenancy-related documentation



• Assist with tenancy deposit administration and financial record management



• Support the onboarding of new landlords and properties, including collecting, saving and organising compliance documentation



• Prepare, save and maintain accurate tenancy, onboarding and lease documentation within company systems



• Support with tenancy setup administration and any related documentation required throughout the setup process



• Maintain organised records, documents and compliance information across the business



• Assist the property management team with maintenance administration, contractor coordination and certificate renewals where required



• Support general customer service enquiries and day-to-day operational administration across the business



• Work closely with the directors and wider team to help maintain organised systems, accurate records and efficient day-to-day operations across the business



What We’re Looking For:



We are looking for someone who is highly organised, proactive and comfortable supporting the day-to-day operations of an expanding business.



A successful candidate will have strong attention to detail, excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage administrative responsibilities accurately and consistently across multiple areas of the business.



You should be comfortable working independently, managing your workload effectively and communicating professionally with landlords, housing providers, contractors and the wider team where required.



The ideal candidate will have:



• Strong organisational and time management skills

• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• A proactive and reliable approach to work

• Confidence using systems, software and online platforms

• The ability to manage multiple administrative tasks efficiently

• A professional and solution-focused mindset

• The ability to work independently whilst maintaining consistent standards

• A willingness to learn, develop and grow within the business



Previous experience in administration, operations, finance support, property administration or customer service would be beneficial, but is not essential for the right candidate.



A typical day in this role may include:



• Processing finance administration tasks and helping ensure all records and payments remain up to date



• Supporting the directors and wider team with day-to-day operational and administrative tasks



• Communicating with landlords, housing providers, contractors and customers via
 and phone



• Organising and saving tenancy, compliance and onboarding documentation within company systems



• Supporting the setup of newly onboarded properties and ensuring records are maintained accurately



• Following up on outstanding information, documentation and administrative tasks where required



• Supporting the property management team with maintenance administration and general operational support



• Managing priorities across multiple ongoing properties, tenancies and operational tasks



• Helping maintain organised systems, accurate records and efficient day-to-day business operations



Working Setup & Hours:



• Full-time remote position

• Monday to Friday

• Working hours aligned with UK business hours (9:00am – 5:30pm UK time)

• One-hour lunch break each day

• Long-term contractor position



Perks & Benefits:



• Ongoing training, guidance and support

• Opportunities for career progression and increased responsibility over time

• Exposure to the UK property, supported housing and care sectors

• Supportive and professionally driven working environment

• The opportunity to develop valuable operational, finance & business administration experience

• Working closely with a growing UK-based business with long-term expansion plans



Requirements:



• A reliable laptop or computer suitable for full-time remote work

• A stable and reliable internet connection

• A dedicated work phone suitable for business communication

• A quiet and professional working environment suitable for calls and meetings

• Strong written and spoken English communication skills

• A second monitor or dual-screen setup would be beneficial, but is not essential

• A headset or suitable audio setup for calls and online meetings would be preferred



How to Apply:



When applying, please include a short paragraph answering the following questions:



1. What appeals to you most about this type of operations and administrative support role?



2. What makes you confident in your ability to stay organised and manage responsibilities accurately across multiple areas of a business?



3. What interests you about Freeman Real Estate and this opportunity specifically?



Please also include the words “Operations Support” at the top of your application. If you are organised, detail-oriented, proactive and interested in developing within a growing business, we would love to hear from you.



Freeman Real Estate Ltd.

title: Executive Assistant / Ops Coordinator (Path to Chief of Staff) — AI-Powered Founder Support
description:
I'm a serial entrepreneur running multiple businesses and projects at once now for over 25 years. I need one sharp, organized, deeply trustworthy person to help me run my world — starting as my Executive Assistant and Operations Coordinator, and growing into my Chief of Staff as we build trust over time.



This is not a typical VA role where you wait for tasks. I'm looking for someone who thinks ahead, catches the things I miss, and takes ownership of keeping my projects, calendar, and commitments on track. Someone I can eventually drop into an
 thread or a project and trust to represent me well. Someone is well-organized and assertive and make sure I am on top of everything. 



You will work closely with me every day. Over time, as you prove yourself, you'll get more access, more responsibility, and more pay. The person who grows into this role will become one of the most important people in my operation.



WHAT YOU'LL DO (starting scope)

- Manage my calendar — scheduling, rescheduling, protecting my focus time, preventing conflicts

- Keep my projects organized and on track — you'll be my system for "what's next, what's stalled, what's due"

- Research — markets, tools, people, options for decisions I need to make

- Book travel — flights, hotels, logistics, itineraries

- Use AI tools (especially Claude) to automate and speed up as much as possible

- Social media content writing for one of my companies

- Draft documents, summaries, and communications for my review

- Track follow-ups and make sure nothing falls through the cracks



WHAT YOU'LL GROW INTO (as trust builds)

- Following up with people on my behalf in
 and chat threads

- Representing me in coordination with my team and partners

- Owning entire workflows end-to-end

- Helping manage other tea
mbers

- True Chief of Staff responsibilities



WHO YOU ARE

REQUIRED:

- Excellent written and spoken English (C1 or higher — you'll be communicating on my behalf)

- Genuinely proficient with AI tools, especially Claude — you actively use AI to work faster, not just occasionally

- Strong project management instincts — you naturally track, prioritize, and follow up without being reminded

- Obsessively organized and detail-oriented — you're the person who never lets things slip

- High discretion and integrity — you'll handle confidential information and you understand why that matters

- An eye for design — you can make a document, deck, or system look clean and professional

- Available full-time with overlap around 8 am to 4 pm PST US Pacific business hours

- Reliable internet and power with backups



STRONGLY PREFERRED:

- Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Chief of Staff, Operations Manager, or similar role to a founder or executive

- Experience managing multiple projects or workstreams simultaneously

- Familiarity with tools like Notion, Google Workspace, project management software, and automation tools

- Experience using AI agents or automation workflows (Zapier, Make, AI assistants, etc.)



NICE TO HAVE:

- Experience supporting a founder running multiple businesses

- Light graphic design skills (Canva, Figma, or similar)

- A track record of long-term roles (you stay and grow, you don't hop)



WHAT YOU GET

- $250-$350 USD/month to start for 20 hours of work and will grow to up to 40 hours of work and higher pay over time and more responsibilities, based on experience (paid 2x/month via Wise, Payoneer, or PayPal)

- A clear, real path to higher pay and a Chief of Staff title as you prove yourself — this is not a dead-end VA job

- Direct daily work with a founder — you'll learn how multiple businesses are run from the inside

- 13th-month bonus

- Paid time off after 3 months

- Performance reviews with raise considerations at 90 days, then every 6 months

- Long-term stability — I'm looking for someone for years, not months. The right person becomes irreplaceable.



HOW TRUST AND ACCESS WORK



I want to be upfront about something: I won't hand a new hire access to my sensitive
s and chats on day one. Trust is earned through how you handle the work.



You'll start with calendar, research, travel, and project tracking. As you demonstrate good judgment and discretion over your first 30-60 days, I'll progressively give you more access and more responsibility — including following up on my behalf and handling sensitive matters. By 90 days, the right person is operating as my right hand.



If you're the kind of person who understands why trust works this way, you're exactly who I'm looking for. If you expect full access immediately, this isn't the right fit.



HOW TO APPLY



Send a message with ALL of the following. Applications missing any item will not be reviewed:

1. SUBJECT LINE: "Chief of Staff Path — [Your Name]"

2. A 4-6 sentence introduction. Tell me who you are, what you've done, and why THIS role — not a generic cover letter. I can tell the difference instantly.

3. Your monthly salary expectation in USD.

4. Confirm you can work in the same hours daily overlapping US Pacific Time 8am-4pm (roughly 11pm-4am your time). Be honest about whether this works long-term.

5. ANSWER ALL SIX OF THESE QUESTIONS:



   Q1: Describe a time you supported a busy person (a boss, founder, or executive) and caught something important they were about to miss. What was it, and what did you do?



   Q2: How do you currently use AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT in your work? Give me one specific example of something you automated or sped up using AI. Be specific — I want to understand how you actually think about using these tools.



   Q3: I have 13 different projects running at once. Some are urgent, some are important-but-not-urgent, some are stalled waiting on other people. If you were my Ops Coordinator, how would you keep track of all of them and d
 what to surface to me each day? Describe your system in 4-6 sentences.



   Q4: You have access to my calendar and inbox. You see an
 from someone I've never mentioned, marked urgent, asking me to confirm a payment by end of day. I'm in meetings and unreachable for 3 hours. What do you do? Walk me through your exact thinking.



   Q5: Tell me about a time you were trusted with confidential or sensitive information. How did you handle it, and how do you think about discretion in your work?



   Q6: This role starts as an Executive Assistant and grows into a Chief of Staff. Where do you want to be in 2-3 years, and why does this growth path appeal to you?



6. Attach a 1-2 minute video of yourself (phone is fine) answering this one question: "Tell me about the busiest or most complex situation you ever had to organize, and how you kept it under control." Be specific and concise. Share a Google Drive link with the video.



7. (OPTIONAL but encouraged) Share a link to anything you've made that shows your eye for organization or design — a Notion workspace, a document, a deck, a system you built, a Canva design. Anything that shows how you make things clean and clear.



I'll respond to qualified candidates within 5-7 business days. If you don't hear fro
 in 10 business days, I've moved forward with others — and I'm grateful for the time you put into applying.



NEXT STEPS IF SELECTED



1. Initial 30-minute video interview with me

2. A paid trial assignment ($20 USD) — a real task that shows me how you work

3. Final decision and onboarding within 2-4 weeks of applying



I'm looking for someone special. If that's you, I'd love to hear from you.

title: Ecom AI Performance Video Editor (Limited Spots)
description:
We are an 8 Figure D2C Supplement Brand Video Editor looking to join our team! As our video editing specialist, you will be responsible for editing high-converting UGC ads, direct response video creatives,VSL’s and psychology-based video content to be used across paid marketing channels (primarily Meta).



We are looking to hire someone with 1.5+ years of ecommerce work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience editing paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC content,VSL’s direct response marketing & bonus points if experience with supplement/health brands.



Key Objectives:



-Edit 1-15 high-converting video ads per week from raw UGC footage and stock content

-Transform raw creator footage into polished, direct response ads optimized for Meta platforms

-Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics (CTR, Hook Rate, Hold Rate) through superior editing

-Create multiple variations and iterations of winning ad concepts quickly

-Use data from creative performance on Meta to analyze what editing techniques, hooks, and structures are driving results

-Work with our creative strategist to bring scripts and concepts to life through compelling editing
