-Provide quick turnaround times on revisions and new edits to support rapid testing cycles



Requirements:



-Fully remote

-Fluent in English

-Direct Response Editing Expertise: 1.5+ Years experience editing performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must

-Software Proficiency: Expert-level skills in Adobe Premiere Pro or After Effects or CapCut, Heygen, Veo 3, Higgfield is a must and familiarity with DaVinci Resolve. Mobile editing experience (CapCut mobile) is a plus

-UGC Editing: Extensive experience editing raw UGC footage into high-converting paid ads with native platform aesthetics

-Fast & Efficient: Ability to produce high-quality edits quickly without sacrificing performance. Speed is critical

-Creative & Data-Driven: Understanding of what makes ads perform (hooks, pacing, captions, sound design, effects) and ability to analyze performance data to inform editing decisions

-Portfolio Required: Must provide portfolio showcasing DTC video ads (preferably supplements, health, or e-commerce)

-No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn't know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work

-Excellent cultural fit as per our values above

-Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders

-Understanding of direct response principles and how editing impacts conversion

-Include word "banana" in your application to prove your legit



Accountabilities:



-Edit 10-20 video ads per week from provided scripts, raw footage, and assets

-Create multiple variations of winning ads (different hooks, text overlays, pacing)

-Add compelling captions, text overlays, sound effects, and visual effects that enhance performance

-Maintain consistent turnaround times (24-48 hours for standard edits, same-day for urgent)

-Organize and manage all video assets, footage libraries, and project files

-Collaborate with creative strategist to understand video concepts and execute the vision

Source and integrate b-roll, stock footage, and motion graphics as needed

-Adapt editing style to emerging trends and platform best practices

-Review performance data on edited ads and identify patterns in what's working

-Iterate quickly on underperforming ads and create new versions based on data insights

-Create editing templates and systems to increase output efficiency

-Maintain brand consistency across all video content while optimizing for performance



How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate:



When hiring, we'll work with you to define the KPIs you'll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you're doing a good job after you start.



Initial soft interview, then a technical interview + test project (edit 2-3 ads from provided footage), and a final interview to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8 - 10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.



For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!

title: Cold Caller (Lead Qualification), Remote
description:
Company: Opal (
)

Location: Remote

Type: Full-time

Hours: US business hours, PST or EST

Earning Potential: $1,800 to $4,200/month (base + commission)

About Opal

Opal is a San Francisco fintech startup building the first credit card designed specifically for ad spend. We help DTC brands, agencies, and growth teams scale their advertising without being capped by traditional credit limits. Limits up to $10M, no personal guarantee, no credit check, no annual fee. We recently raised $8M pre-Series A and are scaling our outbound team fast.

The Role

We are hiring master-level cold callers whose sole job is to generate warm leads from cold calls. You will not book appointments. You will not follow up. You will not close. Your one job is to pitch, qualify, and transfer warm leads to our US-based Sales team in real time.

If you are a cold calling specialist who lives for the dial and thrives under volume, this is your role.

Responsibilities



Make 300 to 500 outbound cold calls per day from a provided lead list

Pitch Opal clearly and confidently in under 30 seconds

Qualify prospects against our ICP (monthly ad spend, decision-making authority, fit)

Convert a minimum of 2 to 3 warm leads per day

Transfer warm leads directly to the US Sales team for follow-up and close

Log every call and outcome in the CRM

Hit daily and weekly KPIs on dials, connects, and warm transfers



Important: This Is Not An Appointment Setter Role

To be crystal clear, your job is not to book appointments or act as an appointment setter. Your sole responsibility is to qualify good warm leads from cold calls and hand them off to our US Sales team. The US team takes it from there and converts those warm leads into appointments and closed deals. If you are looking for an appointment-setting role, this is not it.

What You Need



Minimum 2 years of cold calling experience (B2B required)

Strong English communication, American accent strongly preferred

Applicants with unclear English or heavy accents will not be considered

Confident, sharp, and unshakeable on the phone, you handle pushback in real time

Able to work full US business hours, PST or EST

Experience using Orum (or similar parallel dialers like PowerDialer, Nooks, Aircall)

Reliable high-speed internet, professional headset, and quiet workspace

Self-driven, hardworking, and obsessive about hitting volume and conversion targets



Bonus Points



Background selling to marketing, growth, or finance leaders

Experience in fintech, SaaS, or performance marketing verticals

Proven track record of 3+ warm leads per day from cold calls



Compensation



Base: $800 to $1,200/month based on experience

Commission: $25 to $50 bonus per qualified warm lead transferred to the US Sales team

Earning Potential: At 2 to 3 warm leads per day, top performers earn an additional $1,000 to $3,000/month in commission, bringing total monthly earnings to $1,800 to $4,200

Full-time role with long-term growth potential as we scale the outbound team



How to Apply

Send the following to [your
]:



A 60-second voice recording pitching any product of your choice

Your resume

Your daily call volume and warm-lead conversion numbers from your last role

Confirmation you can work PST or EST hours



Only applicants with a voice recording will be reviewed. No exceptions.

s and calls from tenants. You’ll coordinate with our go-to repair people to get issues fixed quickly and cost-effectively.

Asana: For all project-related updates and task management.



: For formal communication, documentation, and external vendors.

Who Fits This Role?

The Organizer: You naturally see the world in checklists and timelines.

The Real Estate Nerd: You understand (or are eager to learn) the rhythm of a renovation—from permits to paint.

title: Dispatcher & Invoicing Administrator
description:
Location: Remote – Pacific Time (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time) | Wednesday – Sunday



Company Overview: Alltemp is a leading provider of HVAC solutions dedicated to providing exceptional service and quality installations to our customers in California and Hawaii. We specialize in residential and commercial HVAC systems, as well as commercial refrigeration, offering comprehensive installation, repair, and maintenance services.



Job Description: We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Dispatcher & Invoicing Administrator to support the daily operations of our HVAC company. This is a dual-function remote role: Wednesday through Friday, the candidate will focus on invoicing, billing accuracy, and administrative reporting; Saturday and Sunday, the candidate will serve as our primary dispatcher, coordinating field technicians and delivering exceptional customer service. The ideal candidate is highly organized, has strong attention to detail, and thrives in a fast-paced environment. This position requires strong communication, time management, and problem-solving skills, and is essential to keeping our operations running smoothly.



Responsibilities:

Dispatching (Saturday – Sunday)

• Schedule and dispatch HVAC Technicians to service calls, installations, and maintenance jobs based on availability, skillset, and location.

• Monitor technician progress throughout the day to ensure timely job completion and adjust schedules as needed.

• Serve as the main point of contact for field technicians, providing support and updates in real-time.

• Communicate with customers to confirm appointments, provide updates, and follow up on service issues.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of jobs dispatching software, ServiceTitan

• Collaborate with the service manager and customer service team to prioritize emergency calls and reschedule as necessary.

• Ensure that all service tickets are closed and invoices are sent out properly with detailed information and customer feedback.

• Properly schedule recalls as necessary

• Follow up on unsold estimates on a timely basis and keep accurate, detailed notes about the unsold estimates

• Timely and efficiently schedule preventative maintenance calls.

• Accurately and timely tag all incoming phone calls indicating the source of the call, reason for the call, etc. 

• Follow up on “abandoned calls” list daily. 

• Send timely, accurate daily and weekly reports to the executive team as required

• Maintain a high level of professionalism and customer service in all interactions.

• Assist with special projects and initiatives as needed to support the overall goals of the company.

• Other responsibilities as assigned.



Invoicing & Administrative Reporting (Wednesday – Friday)

• Review and process all completed job invoices in ServiceTitan and Quickbooks, ensuring accuracy of labor, parts, and pricing before sending to customers.

• Follow up on outstanding and unpaid invoices, coordinating with customers and the accounting team to resolve billing discrepancies.

• Prepare and submit accurate daily and weekly administrative reports to the executive team, including job summaries, revenue snapshots, and technician productivity metrics.

Fluent in English, both written and verbal

Strong understanding of full-cycle accounting and bookkeeping

title: Creative Strategist - US Market
description:
Fill out form: (ADD PORFOLIO IN FORM)





About Us



We operate a portfolio of performance-led DTC brands across the US and Southeast Asian markets. Our brands are in the 7–8 figure range, and our growth is built entirely on creative research, testing, iteration, and the discipline to do all three at volume.



We run a structured, data-driven creative system. Testing velocity and iteration discipline are what determine how fast we grow. If you want to work somewhere that treats creative strategy as a real performance function, not a vibes-based exercise, this is it.



As a US Creative Strategist, you'll be dedicated to our US market brands, developing and testing concepts for American audiences with the specific buyer psychology, market awareness stages, and offer positioning that move cold traffic in that market.

 

Compensation

This role offers a competitive base salary plus performance-based commissions tied directly to winning concepts that validate and scale. You earn more when your creative drives results - it's that simple.

 

What You'll Be Doing



Research & Concept Development

•   	Developing 15–20 net-new concepts per week across video and image formats. Typically, video concepts make up 70–80% of your weekly output, with image concepts making up the balance; this ratio shifts based on what's scaling and where the priorities are

•   	Conducting deep research into high-impact angles, unique mechanisms, and market awareness stages to develop breakthrough concepts for US audiences

•   	Studying competitive intelligence (ad spying), consumer psychology, mass desire, and internal winners to identify untapped opportunities specific to the US market

•   	Building concepts that are rooted in how American buyers think, what they respond to, and what's already saturated in the market



Scriptwriting & Creative Execution

•   	Writing compelling, high-converting direct-response scripts designed to hook cold US audiences and drive them to purchase (and potentially work in tandem with a dedicated copywriter)

•   	Producing clear, detailed briefs for editors and designers - tight enough that the execution team can move fast without ambiguity

•   	Owning the creative pipeline for your assigned brands: research ? ideation ? scripting ? post-launch performance analysis and iteration

•   	Writing across formats: UGC-style scripts, direct-address video ads, static ad copy, and image concept briefs with the same conversion logic applied to each



Collaboration & Iteration

•   	Working closely with the Lead Strategist at the strategic level and with editors and designers at the execution level

•   	Leveraging proven copy structures, frameworks, and past winners to accelerate testing velocity

•   	Feeding insights back to the wider team to continuously improve our creative playbook



Performance Analysis & Scaling

•   	Analyzing winners and losers weekly - documenting what worked, why it worked, and what to test next

•   	Rapidly iterating winning concepts into multiple variations to validate and scale

 

What We're Looking For



Must-Haves

•   	Proven direct-response experience > you've written scripts, hooks, or ad concepts that have run on Meta or TikTok (paid socials)

•   	Strong copywriting skills across video and static formats > your writing pulls people in and keeps them moving toward a purchase

•   	Deep understanding of consumer psychology, awareness stages, and what makes cold traffic convert in the  target market

•   	Obsessive researcher > you go beyond surface-level competitive intel and find angles other people miss

•   	High output capacity, averaging 15–20 concepts a week, is the expectation, not the ceiling, and you can sustain it without the quality slipping



Instant No's

•   	You don't have real experience in ad creative strategy or direct-response copywriting

•   	You want to spend weeks polishing one campaign > this role requires speed, iteration, and high-quality output simultaneously

•   	You struggle with volume, operational workflows, or fast feedback cycles

•   	You're uncomfortable with the reality that most ads fail before one wins > failure is data, not a problem

•   	You're balancing multiple jobs or clients > this requires full-time, dedicated ownership

 

What Success Looks Like

•   	Consistently producing 15–20 net-new concepts per week across video and image formats

•   	Achieving a 10%+ creative hit rate -concepts that validate, scale, and drive real spend

•   	Operating as a reliable creative partner to the editors, designers, and lead strategists around you

 

Why Join Us

•   	Hands-on experience working on 7–8 figure brands with real paid media budgets behind them

•   	Performance-based upside - base + commissions tied directly to winners and scaling impact

•   	High ownership - your concepts directly influence spend, revenue, and growth

•   	Rapid learning environment with proven frameworks, strong feedback loops, and high iteration cadence

•   	Clear growth path to Lead Strategist or larger brand scope as you prove your output

description:
(Part-time to Long-term)



We're building Torch — a SaaS platform for membership organizations 

(starting with Greek-letter chapters, expanding to nonprofits, HOAs, 

and similar). Built on Laravel + modern frontend stack, multi-tenant 

architecture, currently in active development with a small senior team.



We need a senior full-stack engineer to own our communications 

infrastructure module (SMS,
, group messaging) end-to-end.



WHAT YOU'LL BUILD:



- Twilio integration with multi-tenant subaccount architecture

- Resend
 integration (transactional + broadcast)

- GroupMe and Slack broadcast adapters

- A custom block-based
/SMS composer (using TipTap or Lexical)

- Audience segmentation and scheduled-send infrastructure

- 10DLC compliance workflow for US carriers

- Delivery tracking, opt-out handling, and analytics



This is the core module of our Q3-Q4 2026 product launch. You will 

own it from schema to UI to production. You'll work directly with 

our tech lead and report to the founder.



REQUIRED SKILLS:



- 5+ years Laravel OR Node.js (we run Laravel; transferable Node 

  experience is fine if Laravel learning curve is short)

- Has shipped Twilio integrations in production (not just dabbled)

- Multi-tenant SaaS architecture experience

- Comfortable with API integrations, webhooks, queues

- Can ship end-to-end: backend ? API ? frontend UI

BONUS SKILLS:



- Prior experience at Twilio, Postmark, Resend, 
, Klaviyo, 

  Iterable, SendGrid, or similar messaging companies

- Built internal messaging platforms at Series B+ SaaS companies

- 10DLC / A2P compliance experience

-
 deliverability knowledge (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, bounce handling)

- TipTap or Lexical editor framework experience



COMPENSATION: Competitive USD hourly rate based on experience. 

Please include your expected rate in your application.



HOURS: 10-40/week



START DATE: Late June 2026



TO APPLY:



1. Send a short intro (who you are, what you've shipped)

2. Include 1-2 examples of messaging infrastructure you've built

4. Answer this question in your reply: "What's the hardest part of

   this carefully

title: Social Media Manager for Fashion Brand
description:
We are hiring a highly organized and proactive part-time Social Media Manager to own social media strategy and day-to-day content operations for our brand Bare Babe. Bare Babe is a fast-growing bra accessories brand in the U.S. market. We sell premium nipple covers, sticky bras, boob tape, and related products.



This role will manage our social media channels, primarily TikTok and Instagram, including content strategy, content planning, creator briefs, creator coordination, posting, captions, scheduling, and engagement.



We are looking for someone who understands how to create content that feels native to each platform, has a strong eye for trends, and can help build both brand awareness and community around Bare Babe.



We need someone who is responsive, great at communication, highly organized, and able to keep content moving without things slipping through the cracks.



Main Responsibilities

- Review our current social media accounts and help develop a clear content strategy

- Create weekly and monthly content plans based on seasonal goals, product launches, and trends

- Plan content ideas, hooks, captions, and creative direction

- Create content briefs for creators and designers

- Coordinate with content creators to get content made efficiently

- Work with creators to revise content as needede

- Schedule and publish posts across platforms

- Write captions and ensure posts are on-brand, clear, and engaging

- Work closely with the founder to follow brand guidelines and improve content quality over time

- Manage community engagement, including responding to comments and engaging with similar profiles

- Track what content is performing well and use insights to improve future content

- Help improve social media systems, workflows, and processes over time



Qualifications

- Strong fluent English communication required

- Excellent organization, communication, and project management skills

- Strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram, social media trends, and short-form video content

- Ability to identify strong hooks, viral content angles, and platform-native content ideas

- Comfortable managing creators, designers, and video editors

- Able to keep multiple pieces of content moving at once without missing details

- Experience working with fashion, beauty, lifestyle, or e-commerce brands preferred

- Comfortable collaborating in Google Docs, Slack, and Asana

- Proactive, self-managed, and able to take ownership of projects without needing constant direction



Position Details

- Starting part-time, with the ability to move into full-time as workload increases

- Remote

- Must have working hours that overlap reasonably with ICT timezone (Thailand) to review work with the founder

- Long-term opportunity with room to grow



To Apply Please Include

- Your resume

- A short summary of your relevant social media experience

- Links to social media accounts or brands you have managed

- Examples of content strategies, calendars, or campaigns you have worked on

- Examples of short-form video content, creator briefs, or social media posts you helped create or manage

- Any fashion, beauty, lifestyle, or e-commerce brands you have worked with
